title: USC Housing: Spring 2027 Admission and Housing Details
text:
USC Housing: Spring 2027 Admission and Housing Details (page content for Spring 2027 unless noted).

ELIGIBILITY
- Students admitted for the spring semester may submit a housing application. The page refers them to the new-student Application and Contracting Procedures pages.
- Spring freshmen are not assured an assignment. Freshmen are given priority for available undergraduate housing, but most will be placed in non-freshman undergraduate buildings.
- Transfer undergraduates, continuing non-resident undergraduates, and new and continuing graduate students are not assured an assignment and will be placed on a space-available basis.
- 'Housing for spring is often very limited.' USC Housing has just under 7,000 undergraduate bed spaces, prioritized for new freshmen and rising sophomores. Freshman housing is usually full at the start of fall; only spaces vacated by fall residents can be offered to spring freshmen.
- Applicants may not get their top preferences or requested roommates.

APPLICATION TIMELINE
- Applications open July 1, 2026. USC Housing says 'you should apply early for the best chance of getting a housing assignment.' Most applications are expected on July 1.
- Assignments are based on application date, gender, and availability.
- Assignments will be made in late November 2026. Students are notified by e-mail and directed to the USC Housing website to confirm contracts.
- Spring-assigned students are not eligible for reassignment before Move-In. Over-the-counter reassignment begins mid-January.

KEY DATES
- January 7, 2027: Spring Move-In Day.
- Mid-January 2027: Over-the-counter reassignment begins.
- May 12, 2027: Check-out day for academic year (9-month) contracts (2026-2027).
- July 31, 2027: Check-out day for graduate full-year (12-month) contracts (2026-2027).

PORTAL AND FEES
- The Housing Application Portal is at housing.usc.edu/portal. This page does not list portal steps.
- This page does not list an application fee or housing fee amounts. It links to separate Housing Fees and Residential Meal Plans pages.

OFF-CAMPUS OPTION
- USC Housing partners with Off-Campus Housing 101 to list private rentals in North University Park. USC does not endorse or guarantee these listings.

CONTACT
- USC Housing Services Office, 620 McCarthy Way, Los Angeles, CA 90089.
- Phone: (800) 872-4632. Email: housing@usc.edu.
